hotels.description: The Raffles name sets a high bar at this tropical barefoot paradise in East Africa's enchanting Seychelles. Elegant pool villas cascade down an emerald hillside on Praslin Island, the archipelago's paradise isle, where nature is at its most extraordinary. Five distinctive restaurants and bars ensure that island seclusion never means sacrificing sophistication. Savour alfresco dining at Losean Restaurant, where panoramic views of the neighbouring Curieuse Island accompany every bite, or immerse yourself in the artistry of Japanese cuisine at The Sushi Room. At the Raffles Spa, treatments draw on time-honoured healing traditions. Beyond the resort, world-renowned beaches, pristine national parks, and an ocean brimming with spectacular marine life invite endless discovery.
